caption: The drawing shows a metallic object composed of several connected parts, placed centrally on a plain light beige background with a rectangular border. The main object is an elongated, concave, double-lobed container with curved ends and a shiny, metallic finish rendered in shades of brown, gray, and green. A curved metal handle, attached on both sides of the container, rises above it, with a thin, twisted chain connecting the handle to the container. Resting diagonally across and leaning on the edge of the container is a long, straight metallic rod or pin with a pointed end, colored in a darker brown. The container casts a soft shadow beneath it. There is a cursive signature in the lower right of the image.
title: Lamp
